🔥🇲🇽 <u>SHCP DOCUMENTS 4.3 BILLION PESO TAX EVASION BY JUEGOS DEL BAJÍO — PERMITS FROM FOX/CREEL ERA</u>

Mexico's Treasury Ministry has formally documented 4,306,799,683 pesos in taxes evaded by casino company Juegos del Bajío, owned by the Rodríguez Borgio brothers and originally licensed under Vicente Fox with Santiago Creel as Interior Secretary. The evasion ran through a fabricated 2019 notarized loan contract — the notary supposedly involved told SHCP in January 2024 he never processed the document. SCJN reviews the case June 4; Justice Lenia Batres is pushing acceptance, Yasmín Esquivel opposes. The old PAN-era corporate-state pipeline still getting unwound.

Source: Contralínea

🇲🇽🏭 <u>SHEINBAUM CALLS FOR NATIONAL DEBATE ON AI AND DIGITAL PLATFORMS</u>

"No podemos ser omisos y decir 'no pasa nada'" — President Sheinbaum opened the door to regulating AI, deepfakes manipulating politicians' voices and images, screen addiction among youth, AI-driven homework dependence, and — the real target — private corporate control over platform algorithms. Several Mexican states already ban cellphones in elementary schools. The debate widens to platform usage duration, electoral campaign AI, and ethical governance of foreign-owned algorithms. Mexico drawing the digital sovereignty line.

Source: Contralínea

🇲🇽🌎 <u>CANADA HITS CANNED VEGETABLES WITH 10% TARIFF — MEXICO EXEMPTED UNDER T-MEC</u>

Canada imposed a 10% tariff on canned vegetable imports Friday, valid up to 200 days. Mexico, the United States, Israel, Chile and developing countries were all exempted — Ottawa cited its existing trade obligations under T-MEC. The Canadian International Trade Tribunal will rule by September 9 on whether domestic producers were actually harmed; if not, the tariff is suspended. Treaty discipline still functioning on the northern border while Washington fires tariffs at the rest of the world.

Source: La Jornada

🚨🇲🇽 <u>HACIENDA CUTS FUEL SUBSIDIES — PREMIUM PAYS FULL IEPS, MAGNA 9.89%, DIESEL 20.89%</u>

Mexico's Treasury Ministry just slashed fuel subsidies for June 20–26 as international oil prices drop. The federation now covers only 20.89% of IEPS on diesel (consumers pay 5.82 pesos/liter), 9.89% on Magna (6.03 pesos/liter), and ZERO on Premium — the full 5.65 pesos per liter passes through. Mexico letting markets clear while keeping the caps that actually matter.

Source: La Jornada

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>PEMEX–PETROBRAS PACT MONDAY: DEEP-WATER, REFINING, BIOETHANOL — SOUTH–SOUTH ENERGY ALLIANCE</u>

Sheinbaum confirmed in her mañanera that new Pemex director Juan Carlos Carpio Fragoso and a Sener team led by Secretary Luz Elena González fly to Brazil Monday to sign the framework MOU with Petrobras — covering deep-water exploration in the Gulf of Mexico, oil production, refining and bioethanol. Mexico’s and Brazil’s state oil companies pooling joint capacity instead of leasing it back from US majors. Two BRICS-friendly state oils building south–south energy sovereignty while Washington still calls T-MEC “one of the worst deals ever signed.”

🔥🇲🇽 <u>URUAPAN MAYOR EXPOSED AS “AVIADORA” — 201,501 PESOS IN GHOST CONGRESS PAY</u>

Michoacán Congress president Baltazar Gaona García (Morena) presents payroll records: Uruapan mayor Grecia Quiroz collected 201,501.80 pesos as a “legislative advisor” to deputy Carlos Tafolla between September 19, 2024 and June 30, 2025 — while simultaneously running DIF Uruapan as honorary president, with public events on the record. The Internal Comptroller of the Legislative Branch is now opening an administrative investigation; restitution is demanded. The opposition plays victim on national TV while their officials quietly double-dip; 4T transparency tools are catching it on the record.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>OXFAM IN CONTRALÍNEA MX: GAZA CEASEFIRE IS FAILING — 1,300 DEAD, 250 CHILDREN</u>

Oxfam International’s Bushra Khalidi, in conversation with Mexico’s Contralínea: “Gaza is being divided again.” Seven months after UN Security Council Resolution 2803, the basic ceasefire objectives are unmet — more than 1,300 people killed since October 10, 2025 (250 of them children), 70% of Palestinians without adequate housing, 1.1 million children without reliable water, zero fully operational hospitals. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher: “silencing the weapons is not enough; dignity must be restored.” Mexico’s position remains: two-state solution, end the genocide, recognize Palestine.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>LA GRAN ESCAPADA: 114,000 TOURISM OFFERS, 6,577 ESTABLISHMENTS, ALL 32 STATES</u>

Sectur’s second annual “Buen Fin” of tourism opens with 35% average discounts, 5% more experiences and 11% more establishments than 2025’s inaugural edition — and for the first time foreign tourists can buy in. Secretary Josefina Rodríguez Zamora: the strategy “looks to incentivize internal tourism” and steady seasonal volatility. Sheinbaum: “the promotions aren’t limited to traveling this weekend.” Firefly tours in Tlaxcala, artisan workshops, community-led routes — the 4T’s bet on domestic demand and small operators instead of all-inclusive enclaves.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>CNTE LIFTS ZÓCALO PLANTÓN AFTER 19 DAYS — STRIKE IN RECESS</u>

National teachers’ assembly votes to enter “reorganization phase” and lift the CDMX encampment after 19 days. Oaxaca’s Sección 22 — the most militant base — swung 12,818 to 3,594 in favor of the recess after SEP put an economic bonus on the table. Secretary Yenny Aracely Pérez says the struggle exposed “the lack of a dignified retirement system” and the unfulfilled promise to repeal the 2007 ISSSTE Law — dialogue with Segob and SEP continues. The fight isn’t over; it’s being repositioned.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>GUARDIAN: SHEINBAUM IS THE WORLD’S MOST POPULAR LEFTIST LEADER</u>

The British paper’s front-page feature “Yo, Claudia” by Rachel Nolan calls Sheinbaum “one of the most popularly democratically elected leaders in the world” with a 70% approval rating — “standing out against the wave of conservative and far-right leaders elected in the Americas in recent years.” A scientist who is the disciplined face of the Cuarta Transformación, and a model the gringos still don’t know how to attack without exposing themselves.
